summary: Master ESG finance and sustainable investment with practical tools for screening, portfolio analysis, disclosure, and governance. Enroll today.
lede: ESG finance and sustainable investment bring environmental, social and governance factors into financial analysis and portfolio decisions. Designed for finance analysts, investment officers, treasury specialists, reporting managers and risk professionals, the course addresses how to turn ESG information into practical investment and reporting outputs. Participants practice assessing data and materiality, integrating ESG factors into investment analysis and portfolio construction, evaluating sustainable finance instruments, and preparing governance and reporting materials.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work where finance, sustainability, and disclosure meet. You should already handle investment analysis, treasury, reporting, or risk work and want a practical ESG finance and sustainable investment framework you can apply immediately.
prerequisites: You need a laptop for template work and dashboard exercises, plus access to spreadsheet software. Familiarity with core finance concepts, investment language, or sustainability reporting will help you move faster through the applied exercises.
